issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning a String, but the solution implementation returns an int. The exercise text even instructs students to check the UML for the expected return type, so this mismatch can mislead students to implement the wrong return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (preferred), and ensure any example text/strings reflect an integer return. Alternatively, if a String was intended, change the solution and template to return String instead. Prefer changing the UML to int to match the solution and expected numeric semantics.
